text.p: Here are highlights from Polish newspapers this morning.
FRONT PAGE POLITICAL NEWS
RZECZPOSPOLITA

- The newly proposed tax law allows tax offices to demand information on all types of bank accounts during routine tax clearing procedures. Any such control should be monitored by courts, Polish Banking Association president Jerzy Banka said.
GAZETA WYBORCZA
- Polish President Aleksander Kwasniewski and Ukrainian President Leonid Kuczma will sign a historical reconciliation agreement between the two countries during Kwasniewski's visit to Kiev today.
ZYCIE

- Polish Prime Minister Wlodzimierz Cimoszewicz will ask President Kwasniewski to veto the newly proposed bill on unmasking former collaborators with the communist intelligence and security services as it threatens the security of top-secret information, Cimoszewicz said.
ECONOMIC AND MARKET NEWS
RZECZPOSPOLITA
- Poland's industrial output in April increased by six percent compared with March and by 15.9 percent compared with the same period last year, a report by the Central Statistical Office (GUS) said.
- State-owned telecom monopolist Telekomunikacja Polska SA (TPSA) will invest 600 million zlotys in facility development and modernisation in the Lublin province, eastern Poland.
- The WSK Mielec SA aircraft maker will open a new assembly plant in Anapolis, Brazil.
The new plant will assemble M-18 Dromader crop-dusters.

- Solidarity trade unions at the Star truck plant in Starachowice, southern Poland, have protested against a capital injection by Sobieslaw Zasada Centrum since a consortium formed by Polish Development Bank (PBR) and Pol-Mot vehicle trader proposed better financial conditions, Solidarity said.
- Poland's Finance Minister Marek Belka has announced that a capital injection to the state-owned PZU insurance firm will take place by July this year.
DZIENNIK PRAWA I GOSPODARKI
- Pending on demand, up to 30 percent of shares in the privatised Bank Handlowy will go to individual investors, the bank's president Cezary Stypulkowski said.
- The cabinet will apply to the National Bank of Poland (NBP), the central bank, for Poland to use part of its hard currency reserves to credit exports, Economy Minister Wieslaw Kaczmarek said.
- Creating a shipbuilding holding including the Szczecin and Gdynia yards and the HCP ship engine maker in Poznan will require up to $100 million, Kaczmarek said.
- Servisco parcel service has a 40 percent share in Poland's parcel delivery market, Servisco general director Witold Rutkowski said.
- Sales of Nestle Poland food processing concern soared from to 777 million zlotys last year from seven million zlotys in 1993, the firm's president Barbara Kux said.
- The OZC power and heating plant in Ostrow Wielkopolski, western Poland, will list its shares on the regulated over-the-counter market (CTO) in autumn, the company said.
PARKIET

- The Polish-US Amplico Life insurance firm plans to launch an old age pension scheme adapted to the changes brought about by social security system reform, Amplico's group insurance director Iwona Ochocka said.
- The listed Polish Life Improvement retail and wholesaler's net profit in April was 2.7 million zlotys due to the sale of shares in the Cersanit Krasnystaw bathroom porcelain plant.
PLI made a net loss of 1.7 million zlotys on its basic operations in that period, which was greater than all of its 1996 net operating profit.
NOTE - Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
